name: Margaretha Josephsohn
title: Accredited Social Worker & EMDR Therapist
description: LGBTQIA+-affirming trauma services. I am an accredited social worker and EMDR therapist and a passionate ally of the LGBTQIA+ community, using a trauma-informed, trauma-focused framework including CBT, DBT, EMDR and attachment-based interventions.

Modalities include Schema Therapy and IFS/parts work.
specialties: sex therapy, kink-friendly, fetish-friendly, sex-positive, LGBTIQA+, Schema Therapy, IFS, trauma, relationships

specialties: trans, non-binary, LGBTQIA+, trauma, dissociation, PTSD, CPTSD, EMDR, Schema Therapy, ACT
